message.content: The Stats tab is currently active, displaying six static metric cards (CPU, Memory, Ticks/Sec, Players, Network, Uptime) with large numerical values and descriptive subtitles. However, **live line charts are not rendered** in this view; the interface consists solely of these summary cards without any time-series graphs or sparklines visible below or within them. The color scheme adheres to a **dark stone aesthetic** (near-black backgrounds with subtle gray borders) accented by **warm ember and amber tones**, seen in the orange icons, active tab highlight, "Create server" button, and network throughput arrows. There are **no apparent visual defects**; the layout is clean, typography is legible, status indicators (green "Online" dot) are clear, and all UI elements appear properly aligned and functional.
